home_title: AGRIBALYSE inventory database: community findings · Sentier
description: Users of the AGRIBALYSE life-cycle inventory database record measured findings here, repeat each other's measurements and report them to ADEME.

documents.title: Findings
documents.description: Measured observations about ADEME's inventory data. Each finding has a status, a record and a public place where it is discussed.

documents.title: Feedback to ADEME
documents.description: What was reported to ADEME and when, what ADEME answered, what is resolved, and what is ready to be reported.

documents.title: Contributions
documents.description: Proposals that go beyond a single finding: mappings, models, parameter scenarios and method variants, each with its checks and reviewers.

documents.title: Import and build
documents.description: Follow the six stages of a licensed local build of AGRIBALYSE 3.2 on ecoinvent 3.9.1, from ADEME’s export to the stripped scoring package.

documents.title: Take part
documents.description: Report a finding, repeat a measurement or propose a contribution. Everything is discussed in public on GitHub.

documents.title: Data and terms
documents.description: Which terms apply to ADEME's data, to the ecoinvent background and to what is published here. It is not legal advice.

documents.title: Inventory quality
documents.description: Evidence about the resulting inventory, including supplier links, amendments, impact factors and agreement with ADEME.

documents.title: Data (JSON)
documents.description: The findings and contributions of this site as JSON files for other tools, with their schemas and a feed of changes.

documents.title: Mapping the inventory
documents.description: How AGRIBALYSE inputs are linked to ecoinvent suppliers and elementary flows to EF 3.1.

documents.title: Build runs
documents.description: The licensed local import and the automated checks that accompany it.
